grammar_operator_semantics_note: Derived from THIS bundle's own parent chain (00_tables_index.json shred.parent_table_candidate), not from a previous LOB. Of 5245 resolved hops, 5098 land on an ANCESTOR of the start view (depths 1 to 6), 3 land on the start view ITSELF (depth 0), and 2 land on neither ancestor nor descendant - NONHLTH_TRV_UWR_VW_DATA_PREMIUM_DETAILS reaching NONHLTH_TRV_UWR_VW_DATA_POLICY_DETAILS, two siblings under the feed root. The operator is therefore a LOWEST-COMMON-ANCESTOR cross of which the climb is the degenerate case. A climb-only resolver silently returns nothing for those 2 hops and the miss reads downstream as a source gap.

grammar_level_skipping.note: 1479 hops skip at least one level. Every one must be expanded into its real per-level chain from shred.parent_table_candidate; the intervening views are the walk-only casts.

destination_token_resolution.rule_note: Resolve an abbreviated destination token by matching table_name.endswith('_' + token) AGAINST THE START VIEW'S OWN ANCESTOR CHAIN, never against the whole index. Globally, PARTY_PROPERTY has TWO candidates (..._MEMBER_DETAILS_PARTY_PROPERTY and ..._PROPOSER_DETAILS_PARTY_PROPERTY) and a global lookup silently picks the wrong one on up to 145 hops. Scoped to the start view's ancestors, resolution is unique on all 297 with 0 failures and 0 ambiguities - proved, not assumed.

key_guard_idioms.verified_note: The mapper's 103 / 19 split reproduces EXACTLY over the tier4_content_hash population (target + augmentation, n=127). 103 rows use coalesce(nullif(trim(C),''),'') per component - required, because NULL || 'x' is NULL in ANSI SQL and one unguarded component annihilates the whole hash. 19 rows are SINGLE-component hashes md5(normalise(nullif(trim(X),''))) where the guard IS the composite, and which correctly yield NULL rather than a shared constant when the input is blank (BUILD_RULES.md 5.5). BOTH ARE CORRECT IN THEIR CONTEXT. DO NOT NORMALISE EITHER. A third idiom the mapper does not name exists on 4 rows - bare coalesce(COL,'') with no trim - so a whitespace-only value hashes differently from a blank one; it is the 'after' form recorded in 04d_hashfix_log.json.

spreadsheet_note_columns.note: This workbook uses NO _note suffix convention. Prose lives under identifier-shaped headers instead ('Rationale', 'Note', 'Detail', 'Reason / Rationale', 'Key / Grain / Derivation', and the defective 'Review Flags'.'Source Column'). Every column therefore had to be classified by its VALUES; no header could be trusted either way. Nothing here is consumed by the build - 04_column_map.json is - so no prose column reaches generated SQL via the workbook.

collapse_trap_note: Each entry is a child-key leg whose expression is a FIXED LITERAL identical on every row that uses it, so it cannot separate the instances it exists to separate. In all 8 cases a co-leg on the same composite DOES discriminate, so none of them collapses a satellite on its own - saying otherwise would be an overstated risk (BUILD_RULES.md 11.8). The spec builder's assertion should therefore be: no key and no child key may be composed of these legs ALONE. Counter-check performed and reported: legs that look constant because they have one EXPRESSION but are column-backed (e.g. SAT_PARTY_BANKING.Account Number Masked = nullif(trim(BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER),'') across 28 rows) are NOT traps and are excluded.
renumbering_ordinal_note: Six spellings exist in the source, found by sweeping the SHAPE of a per-parent ordinal across every column name in 00_tables_index.json rather than by matching a token. The mapper's Section B.5 excluded only RISK_SERIAL_* - two of the six - and that exclusion HELD: RISK_SERIAL_NUMBER and RISK_SERIAL_NO reach zero expressions. But SERIAL_NO slipped through on 11 rows as the SOLE child-key leg of the proposed SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH ('Dispatch Serial Number' = nullif(trim(SERIAL_NO),'')). Add or remove a dispatch line and it renumbers; the existing satellite row changes identity, orphans itself, and a duplicate appears - BUILD_RULES.md 5.1. SEQUENCE_NUMBER, PARAM_SEQ and SR_NUMBER reach no expression today and must stay excluded on any re-issue.

layer_sizing.note: 51 views are on a walk and are NEVER a row's table_name, so 45 percent of the casts this build owes exist for views nothing maps. BUILD_RULES.md 6.1: test whether a view GETS A CAST, not whether it APPEARS IN THE MAP.

bespoke_layers.name: augmented-track alignment shim

The standard augmented layer builds per-map and cannot express that; this is a declared exception under BUILD_RULES.md 6.5, required by 7.7.

bespoke_layers.name: EAV instance fan-out driven by a literal leg
bespoke_layers.reason: 444 child-key legs are pure literals naming a column-as-instance inside a pivot view (e.g. Premium Head Code = 'COVER_PREMIUM' for source column PREMIUM). The unpivot layer must fan one parent row into N instance rows keyed by the LEG LITERAL, which has no source column to unpivot from - the literal IS the instance name. 39 of these legs carry no 'expression' field at all and the generator must synthesise the quoted literal from 'value'.

build_directives.directive_note: A key that resolves to nothing must be REJECTED at build time - never fall through to a bare FOREIGN_KEY operand, never mint a namespace prefix with an empty suffix. Health V2 minted one hub row for an entire feed this way.
build_directives.mechanism: In the wide stage wrap every hub and link key as: case when <expr> is null or trim(<expr>) = '' or <expr> = <the namespace prefix literal> then null else <expr> end. The hub feed already drops null business keys. Emit a per-hub rejected-row count into build_artifacts so the rejection is visible rather than silent (BUILD_RULES.md 9.5).

build_directives.directive_note: Empty string is not NULL in this shredded EAV feed; every ladder operand is nullif(trim(x),'') and the guard must survive any re-derivation.
build_directives.mechanism: The keyrules module emits operands verbatim from resolved_key.expression and never rewrites them. Assert that every non-literal operand in an emitted key is itself nullif(trim(...),'') or a guarded sub-expression.

build_directives.directive_note: Do NOT normalise either guard idiom. Both are correct in their context and the mapper has asked twice that they be left alone.
build_directives.mechanism: Copy content-hash expressions through unchanged; add NO coalesce-placement rewrite rule anywhere in the generator chain.

build_directives.bundle_item: STAGE-0 sweep finding (not stated in the bundle) - BUILD_RULES.md 5.5
build_directives.directive_note: 84 multi-operand content-hash hub keys hash the separator string when every operand is blank, minting one HUB_LOCATION or LNK_PARTY_LOCATION row for every all-blank address.
build_directives.mechanism: Wrap each all-coalesce content hash as: case when coalesce(nullif(trim(c1),''), nullif(trim(c2),''), ... ) is null then null else md5(normalise(...)) end. This ADDS an outer guard and does not touch the inner idiom, so it does not violate the do-not-normalise directive above.

build_directives.directive_note: A link leg must equal the key of the hub it references; a leg that disagrees produces an empty join, which reads downstream as sparse source data rather than an error.
build_directives.mechanism: LNK() legs in this bundle are POSITIONAL, not named. Recover each leg by matching its expression STRING against the set of hub key EXPRESSIONS resolved on the same view (BUILD_RULES.md 4), never against a hub NAME - matching by name picks the wrong instance on a view that keys one hub several times. Assert every LNK leg string appears verbatim as some hub's resolved_key.expression on that view.

build_directives.mechanism: Emit both namespaces as mapped. Isolate the '#' qualifier in ONE function in mtv2_keyrules.py so that a source answer drops it in a single edit across all 210 rows. Add a hub-feed counter reporting rows per namespace prefix into BUILD_STATUS.json.

build_directives.directive_note: Four source column names begin with a digit (1ST_REMINDER_DATE, 2ND_REMINDER_DATE, 3RD_REMINDER_DATE, 64_VB_STATUS) across 7 rows.
build_directives.mechanism: Double-quote every source column identifier in emitted SQL, or at minimum these four. An unquoted 1ST_REMINDER_DATE is a Snowflake syntax error - it fails loudly, but only after the whole generator chain has run, and dbt is out of scope here so the static gates will not catch it.

build_directives.bundle_item: STAGE-0 finding on 5 augmentation child-key legs
build_directives.directive_note: Five legs carry an expression that is a quoted SQL string literal CONTAINING a {TEMPLATE}: '{SUB_IMD_CODE}', '{POL_RISK_ID}#RISK_LOAD_TYPE', '{POL_RISK_ID}#{COVER_CODE}', '{POL_RISK_ID}#IS_CONSUMER_LOADING_APPLICABLE', '{POL_RISK_ID}#JOURNEY_TYPE_RELATIVITY'.

Emitted as-is, the child key becomes that literal TEXT on every row and collapses them; every gate passed it because a quoted string is valid SQL.

build_directives.directive_note: 205 rows target a satellite that data_7.js declares multi-active, declare child_key / child_key_value as a STRING, and supply NO child_key_components.

Stage-0 default if nobody rules before stage 1: bare HASHDIFF for the 45 satellites OPUS builds, HASHDIFF_<SAT> for everything else, and name the split explicitly in BUILDER_DECISIONS.

build_directives.directive_note: 128 live key expressions call normalise(), which is not a Snowflake builtin and which the bundle never defines.

name_injectivity_note: All 113 views needing a cast map to 113 distinct abbreviated names with zero collisions and a longest of 49 characters, so no truncation is required and BUILD_RULES.md 7.5's digest requirement does not bite on this bundle. If a re-issue adds a colliding view, the recorded fallback is name[:45] + '_' + md5(full_view_name)[:8], which was also proved injective over this set. Truncation without the digest is NOT injective here: the two longest views differ only at position 69 (MEMBER_DETAILS vs COVER_DETAILS branches) and share a 68-character prefix.

undetermined.what: Whether the FOREIGN_KEY round-trip to the root business number holds 1:1.
undetermined.why: 00_tables_index.json carries sample_data_available=false and sample_data_files={}; the mapper states plainly that no sample data exists anywhere in this run, and this stage has no data access. Nothing in the bundle can settle it.
undetermined.consequence: If the round-trip does not hold, the hub keys on 875 rows across 26 start views are not empty but WRONG, and their satellites hang off a hub population that does not correspond to real policies or claims. Recorded as undetermined, explicitly NOT as a pass.

undetermined.what: The exact population the mapper means by '733 rows depend on the FK round-trip'.
undetermined.why: Three defensible definitions give three numbers and none is 733: 875 rows mention FOREIGN_KEY in a live key expression, 863 use spine[FOREIGN_KEY -> ...], 861 carry a raw FOREIGN_KEY last-resort operand. Narrowing to tier3_spine gives 750; narrowing to spine[FOREIGN_KEY -> ...] AND tier3_spine gives 738, the closest. Split by outcome the exposure is 335 mapped and 540 augmentation.
undetermined.consequence: The bundle's figure is measured over a narrower population than the true exposure and understates it by roughly 140 rows. BUILD_RULES.md 11.8 requires an understated risk be corrected as seriously as an overstated one. Stages 1 to 3 should size this at 875.

undetermined.what: The definition behind '184 rows normalised to the qualified HUB_RISK_OBJECT form'.
undetermined.why: The delivered qualified population is exact and verified - 210 rows within HUB_RISK_OBJECT, 212 across all hubs, matching the mapper's own '210 rows drop the qualifier' - but 184 counts rows CHANGED by a remediation pass, a delta against a pre-remediation snapshot rather than a property of the delivered map.
undetermined.consequence: None for the build. Recorded so that nobody tries to reconcile 184 against the delivered map, fails, and concludes the map is wrong.

undetermined.why: 128 live key expressions call it. It is not a Snowflake builtin and the bundle never defines it anywhere across 40 output artifacts.
undetermined.consequence: Content-hash keys on HUB_LOCATION and LNK_PARTY_LOCATION cannot be emitted until it is defined, and two builds choosing different definitions mint two hub key spaces for the same address - a silent shared-vault split. Must be settled before any load.

undetermined.what: Whether OPUS's bare HASHDIFF or the Maximus HASHDIFF_<SAT> wins on the satellites both feeds write.
undetermined.why: This is the open shared-vault item in BUILD_RULES.md 12, owned by the build owner, and it is a decision about already-loaded data, not something stage 0 can derive.
undetermined.consequence: If Maximus writes HASHDIFF_<SAT> against an OPUS-written hub key, change detection reads NULL, concludes 'changed', and inserts on every load. Measured exposure: 33 standard plus 12 augmented OPUS satellites, all bare HASHDIFF, against a map targeting 90 existing satellites.

undetermined.what: Whether the 60 R-MOTOR dormant columns are populated on a travel feed.
undetermined.why: They sit on a shared non-health platform pivot serving several lines. Presence on the view is not evidence of population and there is no sample data.
undetermined.consequence: If they ARE populated for travel, 60 columns are lost silently. Left unmapped per the mapper's ruling; recorded here so the loss is visible.

undetermined.what: Whether the 2 sibling-crossing hops are the only ones this grammar will ever contain.
undetermined.why: They were found by resolving every one of 5245 hops against the parent chain, which is exhaustive over what is present today. But a re-issue adding a sibling cross would not announce itself, and 2 in 5245 is small enough that a climb-only reader looks correct on any sample.
undetermined.consequence: The resolver must implement LCA crossing, not climbing, even though 99.96 percent of hops are climbs. A climb-only resolver returns nothing for NONHLTH_TRV_UWR_VW_DATA_PREMIUM_DETAILS.COLLECTED_PREMIUM and .OUTSTANDING_PREMIUM, and the miss reads downstream as a source gap - the exact failure mode BUILD_RULES.md 2 was written for.

undetermined.what: Whether the 84 all-blank-collapsible content hashes ever actually receive an all-blank row.
undetermined.why: No sample data. The defect is structural and certain; its INCIDENCE is unknown.
undetermined.consequence: The outer guard costs nothing and is proposed unconditionally. Recorded as undetermined so the fix is never later described as having prevented a measured problem.

undetermined.what: Whether the 24 pivot views need one unpivot per view or one per instance family.
undetermined.why: 444 literal child-key legs identify column-as-instance families, but the map does not group them: the family membership must be inferred from (satellite, leg name) co-occurrence, and two families on one view are indistinguishable from one family with two legs without values.
undetermined.consequence: Stage 1 must derive the grouping and PRINT it (BUILD_RULES.md 9.5). Getting it wrong produces either too few unpivot branches - silently dropping instances, invisible to every check but coverage - or too many, which is merely wasteful.

unstable_child_key_legs_note.SAT_POLICY_DOCUMENT_DISPATCH.Dispatch Se: expression = nullif(trim(SERIAL_NO),'') - a renumbering ordinal, and the SOLE leg. 11 rows.
unstable_child_key_legs_note.SAT_RISK_PERSON_MEMBER.Member Sequence: expression = nullif(trim(KEY_HASH),'') - the SHRED ROW HASH, which changes whenever that node's payload changes. Not hub-grade stable (BUILD_RULES.md 5.1). 2 rows.
unstable_child_key_legs_note.SAT_CLAIM_RESERVE_HEAD.Reserve Head Code: expression = 'LOSS' || '#' || coalesce(nullif(trim(COVER_CODE),''),'') - degenerates to the constant 'LOSS#' when COVER_CODE is blank. 2 rows.
unstable_child_key_legs_note.SAT_PARTY_DIGITAL_IDENTITY.Active Sequen: expression = 'GH_TYPE_OF_USER' - a source COLUMN NAME used as the literal value of a leg the model calls a sequence number. Discriminates (column-as-instance) but the model leg name and the supplied value disagree. 2 rows.
unstable_child_key_legs_note.SAT_COVERAGE_SUBLIMIT_SCHEDULE.Active Se: expression = nullif(trim(SUBLIMIT_NAME),'') - a NAME supplied for a leg the model calls a sequence number. This is MORE stable than an ordinal and is reported as a deliberate, beneficial divergence, not a defect. 3 rows.
